groups.title: Eye Drops (180137COS)
groups.efficacy: This is an over-the-counter medicine used for allergic conjunctivitis.
groups.usage: Instill 1 drop into the affected eye as a single dose, 2 to 4 times a day, or as appropriate for your condition. For infants and young children, follow the doctor's instructions.
groups.caution:
Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or if the patient is a child under 1 year of age.

Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are receiving allergy treatment (such as desensitization therapy), have experienced allergic symptoms from a medicine, have eye pain accompanied by itching, are unsure whether the symptoms are due to an allergy, or are pregnant or breastfeeding.

If your vision becomes blurred after instillation, do not drive or operate machinery until your vision clears. Drowsiness or a sedative effect may rarely occur, so take care when driving or operating machinery.

If there is no improvement after about 1 week of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Keep to the stated dosage and schedule. Use this medicine in the eye only.

If the tip of the container touches the eyelid or eyelashes, the solution may become contaminated or cloudy, so avoid letting the tip touch the eye directly; do not use the solution if it has become cloudy.

To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with others as far as possible.

If you use this medicine together with other eye drops, wait at least 5 minutes between them.

Do not use it while wearing soft contact lenses, and wait at least 15 minutes after instillation before putting your lenses back in.

summaryTable.Ask the pharmacist: Ask the pharmacist in the store first if any of the cautions above apply to you.

groups.title: Eye Drops (228633COS)
groups.efficacy: This is an over-the-counter medicine used for the temporary relief of a burning sensation, irritation and discomfort caused by dry eyes or by exposure to wind and sun, and for the prevention of eye irritation.
groups.usage: When needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye, then discard any remaining solution and the container. If you use this medicine together with other eye drops, wait at least 15 minutes between them to avoid a dilution effect.
groups.caution:
For external use only.

Do not reuse after a single use; be sure to discard any remaining solution and the container.

To avoid contamination, do not let the tip of the container touch any outside surface.

Do not use the solution if its color has changed or if it has become cloudy.

A temporary blurring of vision may occur, so take care when driving or operating dangerous machinery until your vision becomes clear.

groups.title: Eye Drops (228648COS)
groups.efficacy: This is an over-the-counter medicine used for the temporary relief of a burning sensation, irritation and discomfort caused by dry eyes or by exposure to wind and sun.
groups.usage: When needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye, then discard any remaining solution and the container.
groups.caution:
Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it.

Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have severe eye pain or have experienced an allergic reaction to an eye medicine (such as eye redness, itching, swelling or reddening).

Keep to the stated dosage and schedule. Use this medicine in the eye only.

Do not use it as a soft contact lens wetting solution or while wearing soft contact lenses. Remove your contact lenses before using this medicine and put them back in 15 minutes after instillation.

If you use this medicine together with other eye drops, wait at least 15 minutes before using this medicine.

Because of its high viscosity, your vision may blur temporarily when this medicine is instilled.

groups.title: Eye Drops (331800COS)
groups.efficacy: This is an over-the-counter medicine used for dry eyes caused by insufficient tear and mucin production.
groups.usage: Instill 1 to 2 drops into the eye as a single dose, several times a day according to the degree of eye irritation.
groups.caution:
Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it.

If you wear contact lenses, remove them before instilling this medicine and put them back in at least 30 minutes later.

Use this medicine within 1 month after opening. Use this medicine in the eye only.

Keep the tip of the container from touching the eyelids or eyelashes, and do not use the solution if it has become cloudy.

Do not share it with other people.

groups.title: Eye Drops (A25800COS)
groups.efficacy: This is an over-the-counter medicine used for the temporary relief and prevention of irritation and a burning sensation caused by dry eyes.
groups.usage: Whenever needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye.
groups.caution:
If eye pain, changes in vision, or persistent redness or irritation occur, stop using this medicine and consult a doctor.

Before using this medicine, pregnant or breastfeeding women and children aged 6 or under should consult a doctor or pharmacist.

To avoid contamination of this medicine, do not let the tip of the container touch any outside surface.

Remove contact lenses before using this medicine.

Do not use it if the color of the solution has changed or if it has become cloudy.

Close the cap tightly after use.
